_doc: Model pricing, USD per 1M tokens. Owned by this skill: read at runtime by this skill's scripts via _lib/resolve_versions.py (pricing_path/load_pricing), which resolves symlinks first so ~/.claude, ~/.agents and ~/.codex deployments all read this same file. Hand-maintained — no public API resolves provider pricing — so bump last_verified when you re-check the vendor pages. Retired model IDs stay: replaying historical usage logs must price them at the rates that applied then.
